analyticalQuestion: Can the R0.30 convolution majorant be tightened at all orders, and can the canonical logarithms be proved analytic on the full improved polydisc?
supportedClaim: The exact finite range and analytic tail prove H_2=8 and H_L<=27/4 for every L>=3. With K=81/4, the layer bounds give absolute analyticity of a,U,V on max(|Z|,|W|)<4/81. The quotient tails are less than one throughout the same open polydisc, so the logarithms, phi, and the R0.29 exponential factorization are analytic there as well. The degree-119 GMP run is an implementation regression, not the all-order proof or a singularity theorem.
